set.body:
Create a first-class ResponsePreparationPlan covering missing-data policy, censoring, volume weights, nuisance projection, whitening/AR preparation, and robust weighting. Engines should consume prepared response/design blocks rather than reinterpret loose config flags.

Acceptance: plan validation is typed and inspectable; prepared blocks carry provenance; default behavior is byte/behavior compatible with current OLS/GLS/LSS where options are disabled; shared code remains JVM-free.
set.title: Introduce typed response preparation algebra
